timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I got burned pretty badly this morning. Just trying to get a handle on what the hell is going on in Japan.
This whole situation, the whole understanding of radiation, how it works, how it's measured, how it's considered over a lifetime.
There's no official way really to calculate or monitor your lifetime radiation dose.

And I think what people don't understand is that a low dose of radiation has a different effect on somebody who has had a previous high dose of radiation than it would on somebody who has never had exposure to radiation at all.
I'm currently seeking a nuclear physicist to work as an informant for me to help me get a handle on what's going on.
Get a grip on this situation. Just a little more understanding. Feel free to refer me to any sources of information that you are accessing.
Yeah, that is all for now.
